summary: A three-story building complex featuring a long main rectangular spine with two protruding wings forming a U-shape, and a small detached three-story structure situated in the courtyard between the wings. The exterior is characterized by yellowish walls with horizontal wooden and white bands, stone brick corner pillars, and a complex hipped brick roof. A perimeter fence made of spaced white blocks surrounds the property.

shape.overall_form: Long main spine with two perpendicular wings and a detached central structure

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: top horizontal band, vertical pillars, perimeter fence

rebuild_hints: Start by laying out the footprint: a long main spine with two wings extending from one side to form a U-shape, leaving space for a small detached building in the center.
Build the walls up to 3 stories, using sandstone (or similar yellowish block) as the base material.
Separate each floor with a horizontal band of wood planks, and add a final white band at the top of the third floor.
Place stone brick pillars at the inner and outer corners of the building for structural accentuation.
Add white vertical pillars (quartz or concrete) at regular intervals along the facades.
Construct a hipped roof using brick stairs and blocks over the main building and the detached structure.
Surround the entire complex with a low perimeter wall made of single white blocks spaced one block apart.
uncertainties: Exact block palette for the yellowish walls (could be sandstone or end stone bricks).
Exact block palette for the white accents (could be quartz blocks, white concrete, or smooth quartz).
